tools.name: ns_inboundShipment
tools.description: Fetch inbound shipment information, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item, if none item is specified, it will fetch all inbound shipments

itemId.description: The internal id of the item to fetch inbound shipment for

tools.name: ns_inventoryBalace
tools.description: Fetch inventory balance information, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item

itemId.description: The internal id of the item to fetch inventory balance for

tools.name: ns_forecast
tools.description: Fetch forecast information for a given item, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item

itemId.description: The internal id of the item to fetch forecast for

tools.name: ns_OLT
tools.description: Fetch OLT information for a given item, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item

itemId.description: The internal id of the item to fetch OLT for

tools.name: ns_getStandardDataset
tools.description: Fetch all information for a given item, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item

itemId.description: The internal id of the item to fetch all information for

tools.name: ns_getReorderPoint
tools.description: Calculate Safety Stock, Reorder Point, and Suggested Order Quantity for a given item, use findItem custom tool to get the internal id of the item, used to create a demand planning dataset for a given item

itemId.description: The internal id of the item

tools.name: ns_getWeeklyProjection
tools.description: Week-by-week inventory projection for an item, factoring in known inbound shipment arrivals, to calculate the amount needed to order right now (matches the Excel demand planner's rolling projection logic).

itemId.description: The internal id of the item

weeksAhead.description: Number of weeks to project forward. Defaults to 27 (matching the Excel).

tools.name: ns_demandPlanView
tools.description: Interactive view of the demand plan for an item: on-hand by location, on-order, safety stock, and reorder point.

itemId.description: Internal id of the item to display
